facts.fact: WFP's 2025 country report says its support in 2025 included advancing integration of the Karamoja Social Registry into the National Single Registry, with discussions continuing with the Office of the Prime Minister and the World Bank's NUSAF team.

The Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development says the National Single Registry, launched on 4 February 2021, consolidates beneficiary information through linkages with programme management information systems and the National ID database, and that its success rests on establishing those linkages and integrations.

systems.owner: Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development

facts.fact: The FY2026/27 Public Investment Plan lists NUSAF IV (1 July 2025 to 30 June 2030) as establishing a National Social Registry, with the Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development to ensure interoperability and data sharing with UBOS, NIRA, NITA-U, NPA and the Ministry of Local Government; FY2026/27 funding is UShs 44.798 billion, all donor-funded.

facts.fact: Zombo district officials reported that 31 of 61 PDM tablets are inoperative, tablets that support biometric verification and integration with the Wendi digital wallet, forcing a return to manual workflows in half the district's 61 parishes.
